--- arithmetic
on t(x, y)
    return {x + y, x - y, x * y, x / y, x div y, x mod y, x ^ y, -x, x + y * 2, (x + y) * 2, x - (y - 1), x / (y / 2)}
end t
--- comparisons symbols
on t(x, y)
    return {x = y, x ≠ y, x < y, x > y, x ≤ y, x ≥ y, x ≤ y, x ≥ y, x ≠ y}
end t
--- comparisons words
on t(x, y)
    return {x = y, x = y, x = y, x ≠ y, x ≠ y, x ≠ y, x ≠ y, x < y, x > y, x < y, x > y, x ≤ y, x ≥ y, x ≥ y, x ≤ y}
end t
--- containment
on t(x, y)
    return {x contains y, not (x contains y), not (x contains y), x starts with y, x starts with y, x ends with y, y contains x, y contains x, not (y contains x), not (y contains x), not (y contains x)}
end t
--- containment negated
on t(x, y)
    return {not (x contains y), not (x starts with y), not (x ends with y), not (y contains x), not (x starts with y), not (x ends with y)}
end t
--- logic
on t(a, b, c)
    return {a and b, a or b, not a, a and b and c, a or b or c, a and (b or c), a and b or c, not (a and b), not a and not b, a and not (b or not c)}
end t
--- logic with comparisons
on t(x, y, z)
    return {x = 1 and y = 2, x < y or y < z, not (x = y), x ≠ y and not (y = z), x > 0 and y > 0 or z = 0, x = 1 or x = 2 or x = 3}
end t
--- logic as conditions
on t(x, y)
    if x > 0 and y > 0 then
        return 1
    end if
    if x > 0 or y > 0 then
        return 2
    end if
    if not (x > 0) then
        return 3
    end if
    if x > 0 and (y > 0 or y < -10) and not (x = y) then
        return 4
    end if
    return 0
end t
--- logic short circuit values
on t(x, y)
    set a to x = missing value or y = missing value
    set b to x ≠ missing value and length of x > 0
    return {a, b}
end t
--- concatenation
on t(x, y)
    return {x & y, x & y & x, x & "a" & y & "b", {x} & {y}, x & {y}, {x} & y, "a" & 1, 1 & "a", x & (y as text), (x as text) & y}
end t
--- coercion chains
on t(x)
    return {x as text as list, x as integer as text, (x as text) & "s", x & "s" as text, x + 1 as text, x + 1 as text, (x as integer) + 1}
end t
--- reference forms
on t(x)
    set r to a reference to x
    set s to a reference to item 1 of x
    set c to contents of r
    set contents of s to 5
    return {r, s, c, contents of s, a reference to length of x}
end t
--- unary mixes
on t(x, y)
    return {-x + y, x + -y, -(x * y), -x * y, not (x = y), not (x = y), (not x) = y, -(-x), -(-x)}
end t
--- parenthesized author style
on t(x, y)
    return {x, x + y, x + y, x * y + 1, x = y, x = y and x > 0}
end t
--- mixed precedence
on t(a, b, c, d)
    return {a + b * c - d / a, a * b + c * d, (a + b) * (c - d), a + b & c + d, a & b = c & d, a + b = c + d, a = b & c, a < b + c, a mod b = 0, a div b * b + a mod b}
end t
--- power and negation
on t(a, b, c)
    return {a ^ b, a ^ (b ^ c), (a ^ b) ^ c, -a ^ b, -a ^ b, -(a ^ b), a ^ -b, a * (b ^ c), (a * b) ^ c}
end t
--- text comparisons
on t(x)
    return {x = "a", x = "a", "a" = x, x < "b", x < "b", x ≠ "", x ≠ "", "" = x}
end t
--- is in forms
on t(x)
    return {{1, 2, 3} contains x, {1, 2, 3} contains {x}, not ({1, 2} contains x), x contains "a", x contains "a", {1, 2} contains x, "abc" contains x}
end t
--- equality with booleans
on t(x)
    return {x = true, x = false, x = true, x ≠ false, x ≠ true, true = x}
end t
--- equality with missing value
on t(x)
    return {x = missing value, x ≠ missing value, x = missing value, missing value = x, x ≠ missing value}
end t
--- number tests
on t(x)
    return {x mod 2 = 0, x mod 2 = 1, x div 10, x / 10, x div 10 * 10, (round x), (round x / 2), (round x rounding up), (round x rounding down), (round x rounding toward zero), (round x rounding as taught in school)}
end t
--- string operations
on t(x)
    return {length of x, (count x), (count x), (count every character of x), (count every character of x), number of every character of x, number of every word of x, reverse of every character of x, length of x, every character of x}
end t
--- offset
on t(x, y)
    return {(offset of x in y), (offset of x in y) + 1, (offset of "a" in y) > 0}
end t
--- as in conditions
on t(x)
    if x as text = "1" then
        return 1
    end if
    if x as integer > 1 then
        return 2
    end if
    if x as text = "a" & "b" then
        return 3
    end if
    return 0
end t
--- chained comparisons need parens
on t(a, b, c)
    return {(a = b) = c, a = (b = c), (a < b) = (b < c), a contains b and b contains c, (a = b) ≠ (b = c)}
end t
--- containment with a coercion
on t(a, b)
    return {a contains (b as text), (a as text) contains b, (a as text) starts with b, a starts with (b as text), (a as text) ends with b, a ends with (b as text), (a contains b) as text, a = b as text, a < b as text, a contains b & "x", a & b contains "x"}
end t
--- list concatenation building
on t(x)
    set l to {}
    set l to l & x
    set l to l & {x, x}
    set end of l to x
    set beginning of l to x
    copy x to end of l
    copy x to beginning of l
    return l
end t
